improvements: One exact Fraction/Decimal bill-supply compiler for both native engines, with dated inclusive overlapping windows and all consumed inputs retained once.
Known-zero auction days remain in the denominator. Missing amounts, unknown kinds, invalid identities/dates and duplicate occurrences withhold the comparison.
Complete source population coverage is required over both windows. Older desk bank coverage remains unverified; ongoing existing acquisition keeps missing BTC/amount and all source fields.
Desk full-bank pagination validates total pages and counts and applies updates atomically. Missing previously banked identities reject the refresh for review rather than silently rewriting history.
Current headline, added combined history and triggers share the same unrounded base and single final round. Existing base-history fields stay available for complete concern calculations.
Empty-source refresh regenerates the unverified catalog with no current vector and clears combined history/triggers.
Page provides dated sums and distinct auction-day counts, missingness states, complete keyboard-accessible input disclosure and explicit base-versus-combined history labels.
Offline replay rebuilds all normalized rows, occurrence order, permission fields and canonical ledger identity before recalculation; no artifact source code execution.
Obsolete intro claim of cosine historical matching removed; original source documents/outcomes remain unverified.

limitations: All ten platform workstreams remain open. This repair does not establish predictive skill or supported portfolio sizing.

Coverage records are current-vintage complete acquisition ranges, not proof of historical first-publication availability. Legacy desk gaps are not retroactively repaired and may withhold combined scores.
The 28 and 365 day legacy inclusive cutoffs span 29 and 366 calendar dates respectively; comparator overlaps the recent window. This is not YoY, net supply or monetary injection.
The synthetic 22460-row capacity check is local only; native peak capacity and upstream originals/definitions remain separate acceptance work.
Code/package/static acceptance and ordinary producer publication are distinct; original schedules remain unchanged.
